tips.シ|ツ: シ: the short strokes sit on the left, one above the other, and the long stroke goes from bottom to top. ツ: the short strokes sit side by side at the top, and the long stroke goes from top to bottom.
tips.ソ|ン: ソ: the short stroke is fairly vertical and the long stroke runs from top to bottom. ン: the short stroke is fairly horizontal and the long stroke runs from bottom to top.
tips.ソ|ノ: ソ has an extra short stroke at the top left; ノ is a single stroke.
tips.ノ|ン: ン has an extra short stroke on the left; ノ is a single stroke.
tips.ぬ|め: ぬ ends with a small loop at the bottom right; め does not.
tips.ね|れ: Same left half. ね ends with a loop, れ with a flick outwards.
tips.ね|わ: Same left half. ね ends with a loop, わ with a round curve and no loop.
tips.れ|わ: Same left half. れ ends with a flick outwards, わ with a round curve.
tips.る|ろ: る has a loop at the bottom; ろ is open at the bottom.
tips.さ|ち: Mirror images: in ち the lower curve bulges to the right (like a 5), in さ to the left.
tips.き|さ: き has two horizontal strokes, さ only one.
tips.は|ほ: ほ has an extra horizontal stroke at the top right that closes off the vertical stroke. は is open at the top.
tips.け|は: は has a loop at the bottom right; け does not.
tips.け|ほ: ほ has two horizontal strokes on the right and a loop at the bottom; け has neither.
tips.ほ|ま: ほ has an extra vertical stroke on the left; ま does not.
tips.い|り: In り the right stroke is much longer and sweeps downwards.
tips.あ|お: お has a small extra stroke at the top right; あ does not.
tips.あ|め: あ has a horizontal stroke at the top; め does not.
tips.あ|ぬ: あ has a horizontal stroke at the top; ぬ ends with a loop.
tips.た|な: た: two short strokes on the right, like こ. な: a small stroke on the right and a loop at the bottom.
tips.う|ら: う has a horizontal stroke at the top and a round belly; ら has only a short slanted stroke at the top.
tips.ち|ら: ち has a full horizontal stroke at the top; ら only a short one.
tips.こ|に: に has an extra vertical stroke on the left; こ does not.
tips.ク|ケ: In ケ the horizontal stroke sticks out on the right. ク has only two strokes.

t.daku_tip: The two dashes ゛ make the sound voiced: k → g, s → z, t → d, h → b. The small circle ゜ turns h into p.
t.yoon_tip: The small character sets the vowel: ゃ/ャ = ya, ゅ/ュ = yu, ょ/ョ = yo.
t.hint_daku_rev_handaku: Look for a character with the small circle ゜. The circle turns the breathy sound of the H row into a hard lip sound.
t.hint_daku_rev: Look for a character with the two dashes ゛. Think of the base character with the voiceless partner sound: g ↔ k, z ↔ s, d ↔ t, b ↔ h.
t.hint_handaku: Base character: %1$s. The small circle ゜ turns the breathy h sound into a hard lip sound.
t.hint_daku: Base character: %1$s. The two dashes ゛ make the first sound voiced, that is, softer.
t.hint_yoon_rev: Look for a character ending in i plus a small ゃ, ゅ or ょ (or ャ, ュ, ョ). The small character sets the final vowel.
t.hint_yoon: Made of %1$s and a small %2$s. Say both in one go and drop the i in between.
t.table_prefix: In the table it is here:
t.table_alone: It stands alone in the last row of the table, after %1$s and %2$s.
t.rule_sokuon: The small っ/ッ doubles the next consonant: がっこう = gakkou (before ch: tch, e.g. ちょっと = chotto).
t.rule_choon: The bar ー lengthens the vowel before it: コーヒー = koohii.

pt.は: は marks the topic: “as for …”. As a particle it is read “wa”.
pt.が: が marks who or what is or does something – also with “like” and “good at” (すき, じょうず).
pt.を: を marks the object: the thing something is done to (eat, watch, buy). It is read “o”.
pt.に: に shows a destination, where something is (いる/ある) and a point in time: がっこうに いく, しちじに おきる.
pt.で: で shows where an action happens and with what: こうえんで あそぶ, バスで いく.
pt.へ: へ shows the direction: “towards”. As a particle it is read “e”.
pt.の: の links words: possession or kind – わたしの ほん (my book).
pt.と: と means “and” between things or “with” for people.
pt.も: も means “also” and replaces は, が or を.
pt.か: か at the end of a sentence makes it a question.

nt.num_small: Tens plus ones: 47 = よんじゅう (4 × 10) + なな (7). Here 4 is よん, 7 is なな, 9 is きゅう.
nt.num_hyaku: Hundreds are ひゃく: 100 ひゃく, 200 にひゃく, 400 よんひゃく, 500 ごひゃく.
nt.num_hyaku_x: Three exceptions: 300 さんびゃく, 600 ろっぴゃく, 800 はっぴゃく.
nt.num_sen: Thousands are せん: 1000 is just せん, 2000 にせん, 5000 ごせん.
nt.num_sen_x: Two exceptions: 3000 さんぜん, 8000 はっせん.
nt.num_man: Japanese counts in ten-thousands: 10,000 = いちまん, 15,000 = いちまんごせん.
nt.price: Prices: number + えん (円). 1,500円 = せんごひゃくえん.
nt.hour: Time: number + じ (時). 3時 = さんじ.
nt.hour_x: Exceptions: 4時 よじ, 7時 しちじ, 9時 くじ.
nt.minute: Minutes: ふん or ぷん. ぷん after 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10: いっぷん, さんぷん, よんぷん, ろっぷん, はっぷん, じゅっぷん.
nt.month: Months: number + がつ (月). 1月 = いちがつ = January.
nt.month_x: Exceptions: 4月 しがつ, 7月 しちがつ, 9月 くがつ.
nt.day_x: Days 1 to 10, 14, 20 and 24 have their own readings: ついたち, ふつか, みっか, よっか, いつか, むいか, なのか, ようか, ここのか, とおか, じゅうよっか, はつか, にじゅうよっか.
nt.day: The other days: number + にち. 17日 じゅうしちにち, 19日 じゅうくにち.
nt.date: Month first, then the day: 4月10日 = April 10.
nt.c_tsu: つ counts things in general, up to 9: ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ, よっつ, いつつ, むっつ, ななつ, やっつ, ここのつ.
nt.c_nin: 人 counts people: ひとり, ふたり, from 3 on number + にん (4人 よにん).
nt.c_hon: 本 counts long, thin things: いっぽん, にほん, さんぼん, ろっぽん, はっぽん, じゅっぽん.
nt.c_mai: 枚 counts flat things (sheets, plates, shirts), completely regular: いちまい, にまい, さんまい …
nt.c_hiki: 匹 counts small animals: いっぴき, にひき, さんびき, ろっぴき, はっぴき, じゅっぴき.
nt.c_kai: 回 counts how many times: いっかい, にかい, さんかい, ろっかい, はっかい, じゅっかい.
nt.c_kai2: 階 counts floors: いっかい, にかい, さんがい (also さんかい), ろっかい, はっかい.
nt.c_satsu: 冊 counts books and notebooks: いっさつ, にさつ, はっさつ, じゅっさつ.
nt.c_dai: 台 counts machines and vehicles, completely regular: いちだい, にだい, さんだい …
nt.c_ko: 個 counts small, often round things: いっこ, にこ, ろっこ, はっこ, じゅっこ.
nt.c_sai: 歳 counts age: いっさい, はっさい, じゅっさい. 20 years old is はたち.
